scope: Published nominal resistor topology with generic semiconductor parameters; selected 25 C DC points only
interpretation: The generic reverse-beta=1 proxy inverts correctly but exceeds the published high-input-current limit. An explicit input reverse-beta=.01 candidate meets the selected DC points. That candidate is constrained by these test points, not independently validated; no transient/storage, temperature, breakdown, package or specimen calibration is established. Neither profile is adopted in the full-board harness.
